content: Claimed bd-lvyi (per-step harness override). Audit: changes 1-3 already landed in 367c1f4 (headless --harness flag validated pi|omp|opencode|grok; dispatch_spec_harness passthrough + model resolution honors override; debate/goal/plan-review reviewer steps carry harness:opencode; reviewer profile stays omp). GAP = requirement 4 pane path: pane_dispatch errors on ANY override conflict but does NOT resolve to a pane of the overridden harness when one exists. Slice: SpawnEntry gains harness field (set at pre_spawn); pane_dispatch resolves override -> pane-of-that-harness if present (via registry scan), else clear error; unit tests. Files: flywheel/src/pane.rs (+ state.rs).
